comment: Adapters are said to perform representational translation only and not alter clinical meaning. In practice, conversion between models can involve loss, approximation, aggregation, or contextual transformation.

public.text: Adapters are said to perform representational translation only and not alter clinical meaning. In practice, conversion between models can involve loss, approximation, aggregation, or contextual transformation.
public.suggestedRevision: Require transformation specifications to document semantic equivalence, information loss, assumptions, unmapped elements, provenance, validation, error handling, and fitness for the intended use.
